verdict.rationale: Vue's Quick Start documents using Vue from a CDN script tag with no build step, explicitly for enhancing static HTML or integrating with a backend framework. Its homepage describes the ecosystem as incrementally adoptable. A community user independently confirms Vue can be added minimally to existing templates. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on mounting components into specific elements of existing server-rendered markup (in-DOM templates, multiple app instances per page)

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the framework into an existing server-rendered HTML page and render interactive components without rewriting the whole page

citations.quote: This makes the setup a lot simpler, and is suitable for enhancing static HTML or integrating with a backend framework.
A rich, incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a library and a full-featured framework.
Vue is the only one of the top three frameworks that can easily be added minimally here and there to existing templates to spruce up old applications.
